evidence: The growth of copper metal films by ALD was carried out using 1, formic acid, and anhydrous hydrazine as precursors on Si(100) substrates with the native oxide. The number of deposition cycles, the lengths of the formic acid and hydrazine pulses, and the length of the purges after each pulse were kept constant at 1000, 0.2 s, 0.2 s, and 5.0 s, respectively.
